## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 19.05.2026 - 27.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _rybu0305_, 25.07.2026, 1/5: "They removed the ability to easily see the month from the top view and then switch to the schedule view. App is unusable now."
            2. _Heatmiser NeoApp_, 22.05.2026, 1/5: "Apple app icon shows 31st. Should be showing the correct date! Bug only affects Apple devices and not Android"
            3. _Mumakil_, 11.06.2026, 3/5: "It’s not bad but a few changes would get it more stars. The main issues I have are in adding an entry. Why do I have to scroll through months to get to the date I want? Drop downs to select the month and year for things way in the future would be much better. Also occasionally it freezes the keyboard when I try to enter a location. This is the only app I have that freezes anytime I’m entering information so clearly a bug in the app. Lastly why does the app icon show 31 and not the current date like the iOS calendar app does?"
